content:
maya: Morning folks! Quick fun thing — I’m putting together a tiny ‘Santa sticker bounty’ pack to send to remote folks for decorating laptops/monitors/virtual backgrounds. :santa: Who wants one?

jamal: In! Do we have size options or just one sticker? :grin:

sophia: Count me in. Love stickers. :heart_eyes:

elliot: If stickers = instant desk upgrade, i'm down. 😂

maya: Options are: 1) die-cut name sticker, 2) round laptop sticker (3.5"), 3) mini sleigh sticker (for corners). Reply with :one:, :two:, or :three: to vote. I’ll tally Wed.

ops-bot: Poll created by maya — react with :one:, :two:, :three: to vote. Poll ends Wed 15:00 PST.

nina: Also — timezone check: would people want a short, timezone-friendly holiday cheer meetup? Two quick slots I was thinking: 12:30 UTC (works for EU/US morning) or 21:00 JST (APAC evening). 10 min, casual.

jamal: 12:30 UTC works for me. :thumbsup:

sophia: Prefer the JST evening but can make the UTC one if needed.

ray: Throwing in an ugly sweater mini-contest? Prize = sticker pack + $25 coffee gift card. :trophy:

maya: Love the contest idea. I’ll set up a thread for voting on sweaters. Tagging people-ops for budget on gift cards.

lola (people-ops): Hey! We can cover $100 for prizes and shipping. Also can do a digital sticker pack for folks who prefer no mail. DM for addressing.

elliot: Sneak peek of the sticker art I mocked: little Redwood tree with a tiny GPU ornament and a pixelated snowflake. Will post a preview in #design later. Preview link: https://img.example.com/redwood-sticker-sneak.png

maya: Nice! I’ll place the order Friday for anyone who reacted to the poll. If you want shipping, DM me your address. If remote and prefer digital only, tell me here.

jamal: One more tiny ask — can you do an extra mini sticker for the tiny top-right of my monitor? I have limited real estate. :eyes:

maya: mini-sleigh is perfect for that, I’ll make sure there are extras.

nina: For the meetup — maybe we run both slots on Thurs? 12:30 UTC and 21:00 JST, each 10 mins. People can pick which they join.

ray: Sounds good. I’ll enter the ugly sweater contest. Already training my webcam to look festive.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled by maya — Sticker poll ends Wed 15:00 PST.

maya: Thanks everyone! Tiny seasonal cheer only, no pressure. :sparkles: If you volunteer to help ship (stamp/node), DM me.

elliot: Volunteer to help with mailing labels.

sophia: I’ll help with the sweater voting thread on Thurs.

maya: Amazing. Happy almost-holidays y'all! :evergreen_tree: :tada:

jamal: Happy holidays — and thank you for doing this maya!

lola (people-ops): If anyone needs accommodation for shipping (time off or address changes), ping HR privately.

maya: Closing notes — poll link (ops-bot created) and calendar invites pending. Will post final RSVP cut-off Thursday morning.

nina: Love this. See you at the mini-carol(s)! :notes:
